summary: Verified the new Docking-inside-Research feature at both backend and frontend levels for iter46. Backend pytest (test_iter46_docking_autoappend.py) confirms the /api/research plan auto-appends a `docking` step whenever the LLM planner emits BOTH admet_predict AND target_predict — plan tools returned: ['compound_lookup', 'admet_predict', 'target_predict', 'docking']. Frontend (workspace /app, signed in as rtest1785979513@phytonetai.com) renders the PlanCard for that project with all 4 steps including the auto-appended 'Dock curcumin against top predicted targets  DOCKING' row, testid=plan-step-3 present and labelled correctly. Standalone /molecular-docking page still loads (gates on prior workflow steps — pre-existing behaviour; DockingViewer code unchanged). End-to-end docking EXECUTION was NOT run (per review instructions — 10+ min AutoDock Vina batch; feature passes as long as plumbing + auto-append + card contract are correct). DockingCard render was verified by static code review of cards.jsx (lines 846-1036) — all required elements present: 5 summary pills (Pairs / Succeeded / Failed / Strong ≤−7 / Best affinity), best-binder banner when metrics.best_pair is set, sort ascending by best_affinity (Infinity for errored rows), columns Compound|Gene|PDB|Affinity|Strength|Modes|3D View, error rows get opacity-60 with 'Failed' badge, data-testids docking-card / docking-download-csv / docking-row-<i> / docking-view3d-<i> / docking-viewer-wrap-<i> all wired, and DockingViewer is embedded verbatim.
action_items: (Optional) Run a full end-to-end docking test with top_compounds=1, top_genes=1 (~30-60s single pair) in a follow-up manual verification session — this will exercise DockingCard live render + the docking-view3d-0 → docking-viewer-wrap-0 expansion + docking-download-csv. Live execution was skipped here to respect the review's ~10 min runtime cap.

(Minor housekeeping) cards.jsx is now 1600+ lines. Consider splitting DockingCard, CTPNetworkCard, EnrichmentCard, and the Venn / Enrich chart helpers into their own files under /app/frontend/src/components/research/cards/*.jsx for maintainability.
critical_code_review_comments: tool_docking auto-picks compounds via QED / drug-likeness score from prior admet_predict, falls back to any earlier compound source — correct chaining policy.

Gene picker in tool_docking correctly requires uniprot_id (not just gene symbol) — necessary because docking_service.run_docking_batch needs UniProt to fetch a PDB structure. Genes are ranked by ctp_network hub-degree when available, else by evidence count + best score.

Auto-append in research_service.plan() checks `{target_predict, admet_predict} <= tools_in_plan` before appending — same defensive pattern as the CTP auto-append two lines above, no duplicate when already present.
DockingCard sorts by best_affinity ascending with Infinity for errored / null rows — correct (most-negative first, errors sink to bottom).
hasError branch renders opacity-60 row + 'Failed' badge + '—' cells — no crash on partial batches, as required.
Best-binder banner gated by metrics.best_pair — no NaN toFixed crash when zero pairs succeeded.
CSV download uses JSON.stringify per cell for CSV-safe quoting of ligand names / errors — good.
DockingViewer is reused verbatim (imported from ../DockingViewer) — no duplicate 3Dmol.js integration.
Nit: PlanCard already handles the new tool label 'DOCKING' correctly (tool name is rendered via s.tool without any switch).
Nit: docking-viewer-wrap-<i> is rendered inside a <td colSpan={8}> — matches the 8-column table header. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (auto-append + PlanCard verified; full DockingCard render pending live docking run)
